school.title: School
school.description: The school's name shows in the header, the browser tab and mails; the legal notice at the bottom of every page.
school.name: School name
school.legalNoticeHint: For example the imprint: who runs the school and how to reach them. Line breaks are kept.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: The look of the app: its theme, the accent color of buttons, links and highlights, the logo in the header and a background image.
branding.accentHint: As #rrggbb. Leave it empty for the app's own color.
branding.contrast: Contrast {{ratio}}:1 with the text on it
branding.logoHint: The header shows the logo of the receipts. Change it in the receipt settings below.
branding.noLogo: No logo: the header shows the app's mark.

themeHints.programme: Clear cards on a calm page, in the accent color.
themeHints.werkstatt: Condensed type, colored day bands and the rooms side by side, on the school's background image.

background.title: Background image
background.invalid: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of at most {{size}} MB.
background.saved: The background image has been saved.
background.removed: The background image has been removed.
background.hint: A JPEG, PNG or WebP of at most {{size}} MB. Werkstatt shows it behind the page; Programme does not.
background.unreadable: The file could not be read; choose it again.

regional.title: Time and language
regional.description: The school's time zone for every date and time, the language for visitors and mails, and the currency of every price.
regional.timezoneHint: An IANA name such as Europe/Berlin.
regional.timezoneLocked: Fixed: lessons exist, whose times are in this time zone. It is chosen when the school is set up.
regional.localeHint: For visitors, and for mails to accounts without a language of their own.
regional.currencyHint: An ISO 4217 code such as EUR.
regional.currencyLocked: Fixed: prices or receipts exist in this currency. It is chosen when the school is set up.

conflicts.timezone-locked: Lessons exist meanwhile, so the time zone can no longer change.
conflicts.currency-locked: Prices or receipts exist meanwhile, so the currency can no longer change.

rules.title: Booking rules
rules.description: When the schedule is released, until when members book and cancel, and how far ahead they see.
rules.releaseWeeksAheadHint: Each release opens the lessons up to the same day this many weeks later.
rules.manualReleasedThroughHint: Optional: releases the schedule through this day even before the weekly release reaches it. It only extends the weekly release and never holds anything back; once the weekly release passes this day, the date has no effect.
rules.ruleReleasesThrough: The weekly release alone reaches through {{date}}.
rules.manualExtends: This date extends the release: the weekly release alone reaches through {{date}}.
rules.manualNoEffect: This date has no effect now: the weekly release already reaches through {{date}}.
rules.bookingCutoffHint: 0: booking stays open until the lesson starts.
rules.cancellationCutoffHint: A later cancellation still uses the visit of a pass.
rules.waitlistInviteExpiry: A waiting-list invitation holds the place for
rules.defaultVisibleDaysHint: Early access: signed-in members see the lessons this many days ahead, released or not.
rules.previewHint: With these rules, from now on.
rules.previewIncomplete: Rule incomplete: enter a release time, 1 to 52 weeks and a date at most 52 weeks ahead (or none) to see what it releases.
rules.previewFailed: The release window could not be computed.
rules.generated_one: The settings have been saved. {{count}} lesson of the wider window was created.
rules.generated_other: The settings have been saved. {{count}} lessons of the wider window were created.
